# Do not rename autogenerated animation clips

Authoring a native animation clip in the 1.4.8 Modding Kit yields an asset with an autogenerated name (e.g. `new_animation_clip`) and a package GUID; the kit generates a RuntimeDataCache `.rdc` for it. Renaming the clip in the editor made resource resolution invalid and the cache unusable. Keep the autogenerated name and point action XML at it; never write `.rdc` files by hand.

Corollary: source clips (FBX, 25 FPS key ranges) and native clips are separate. A long reload needs a start clip plus a continuation clip, and the action XML, the C# references and the clip names must all agree before shipping.

Related: [[fbx-edits-need-tpac-reimport]]
